footnote_text: 855,987 of these securities are RSUs, each representing a contingent right to receive one share of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock. In addition to the securities reported in this column, the Reporting Person beneficially owns 5,469,161 shares of the Issuer's Class B Common Stock directly and indirectly through various trusts, each of which is convertible at any time at the option of the Reporting Person into one share of Class A Common Stock, and 11,389,366 shares of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock underlying vested options.

This Form 4 concerns (i) the exercise of options to purchase shares of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock that were due to expire in February 2028 and June 2028, respectively, (ii) the related withholding of shares by the Issuer upon the net exercise of such options to pay the exercise prices and required tax withholdings and (iii) the sale of the net shares in a block sale. Prior to such sale, the Reporting Person had not sold any shares of the Issuer's common stock (excluding sales solely to cover required taxes and fees due upon the vesting and settlement of Restricted Stock Units ("RSUs")) since September 2021.

Represents shares that have been withheld by the Issuer upon the net exercise of stock options and used to pay the exercise prices and required tax withholdings. Does not represent a sale by the Reporting Person.
